name: ISO 9001 — Quality Management System
description: Design, manufacture, installation and servicing of passenger and goods lifts operate under a documented quality management system, audited annually.

name: Load and overspeed testing
description: Every car is load-tested to 125% of rated capacity, and the overspeed governor and safety gear are tripped and verified before dispatch.

name: Lift inspection and licensing
description: Installations are prepared for, and handed over against, statutory inspection and licensing under the applicable state lift rules.
